svg.title: A budget note for one agent
svg.desc: The vault enforces the ceiling: the note balance, and a close that pays only your payout account. Your own nymirad enforces the policy: models, limits, rate, approvals and signature checks.
svg.text: A budget note for one agent

g.text: An agent can spend at most the balance of its note.
A close can only pay your payout account, fixed at deposit.
This rests on the vault matching the client’s pins.
nymirad on your machine enforces the policy
model list, lease, call and daily limits, rate limit
your approval for a call above confirm_above_usd
require_tee: an answer is released after its signature is checked
If the note moves to the agent’s machine, the policy is advisory.

svg.text: The agent token starts with nyma_ and reaches chat, models, balance and quote only. No remote kill switch exists.
